source_claim: For one locked user task, a complete paper-derived skill can be compiled into a source-anchored, one-deletion-minimal procedural slice with a simultaneous certificate that its paired net effect is equivalent to the complete artifact and that every retained atom is locally necessary.

axes.problem: Rapidly extract the task-relevant operational core of a paper without mistaking semantic relevance, dependency completeness, or executability for preserved usefulness.
axes.mechanism: Source-anchored procedural atoms, dependency-closed candidate slices, a complete-skill and same-scaffold reference, adaptive paired effect-equivalence certificates, interaction-aware deletion search, and sealed retained-atom deletion checks.
axes.insight: The operational core is task-local and behavioral: it is the locally irreducible source-grounded subset that preserves the complete artifact's measured effect, not the semantically most salient or merely executable subset.
axes.application: PaperToSkill artifacts and independently locked user tasks.
axes.evaluation_scope: Eight development replays plus genuinely new held-out paper-task cases, with task-local effect equivalence, contract and guardrail noninferiority, procedure count, and cost.

comparisons.title: Graph-of-Skills: Dependency-Aware Structural Retrieval for Massive Agent Skills
comparisons.evidence: Graph-of-Skills constructs executable dependency graphs and retrieves bounded dependency-aware bundles; it optimizes structural completeness and task reward, not per-task effect equivalence to a complete source artifact or one-deletion necessity certificates.
comparisons.limitations: It defeats broad novelty claims about dependency-aware compact skill selection.

comparisons.title: SkillRAE: Agent Skill-Based Context Compilation for Retrieval-Augmented Execution
comparisons.evidence: SkillRAE compiles compact, grounded, task-specific contexts and uses rescue-aware evidence recovery, but its abstract does not define or certify equivalence to the complete artifact's paired effect.

comparisons.title: ClawTrace: Cost-Aware Tracing for LLM Agent Skill Distillation
comparisons.evidence: ClawTrace compiles preserve, prune, and repair patches from cost-attributed traces and analyzes their quality effects, but does not derive a source-grounded effect-equivalent slice or certify retained atom necessity.
comparisons.limitations: Only the abstract was available in the local cache.

comparisons.title: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
comparisons.evidence: The framework measures whole-skill marginal utility with and without a skill; it does not reduce one skill into a source-grounded slice while preserving that measured effect.
comparisons.limitations: It supplies the strongest whole-skill utility baseline and defeats broad skill-utility novelty claims.

comparisons.title: Anything2Skill: Compiling External Knowledge into Reusable Skills for Agents
comparisons.evidence: Anything2Skill compiles evidence windows into structured procedural contracts, but does not behaviorally minimize them against a complete-artifact local-effect reference.
comparisons.limitations: It defeats broad claims about first evidence-grounded skill compilation.

comparisons.title: SkillFoundry: Automated Mining and Validation of Agent Skills for Scientific Tasks
comparisons.evidence: SkillFoundry mines and validates executable skill contracts and then evaluates downstream utility, but does not emit effect-equivalence and retained-deletion certificates relative to the full artifact.
comparisons.limitations: The overlap is substantial at compilation, validation, and downstream evaluation layers.

limitations: Candidate-specific external collision terms were not transmitted; the assessment reuses local structured evidence.
Behavior-preserving program reduction, statistical delta debugging, prompt pruning, and minimal-sufficient-rationale families remain unresolved parametric threats.

One-deletion minimality, paired equivalence testing, provenance, and deletion search are prior tools; novelty can only rest on the source-grounded task-local effect-preservation object and compiler contract.
The current candidate must gate certification on the complete artifact having a nontrivial positive local effect and must not call a one-deletion-minimal slice globally smallest.
